item.title: Canucks Trade Rumors: 8 Destinations Listed for Elias Pettersson
item.description: What is the future for Vancouver Canucks' Elias Pettersson in the midst of another disappointing season? For the second straight year, he's far underperformed on his $11.6 million AAV (and there's still six more seasons to run after this one). What teams are willing to take on that monstrous commitment, even with a retention of some sort by the Canucks? Per Daily Faceoff's Matt Larkin, there are plenty. And for good reason. item.description: The Vancouver Canucks have no other logical choice than to continue to sell. item.title: NHL Trade Rumors: Islanders Had Prefered Target Over Palat
item.description: The New York Islanders swung two trades this past week with Tri-State rivals, the second one bringing in Ondrej Palat and his $6 million cap hit for another year from the New Jersey Devils. Despite only coming in with four goals and 10 points in 51 games with Jersey, the veteran forward immediately made an impact, with two points and a power play goal in his first game with the Isles. item.title: Rangers claim Vincent Iorio off waivers from Sharks
item.description: The New York Rangers have added some depth to their blueline as the team announced they've claimed defenceman Vincent Iorio off waivers from the San Jose Sharks. Iorio was waived by the Sharks on Friday, and now finds a new home on a struggling Rangers roster. item.title: Maple Leafs Trade Rumors: Dennis Hildeby Linked to Metropolitan Club
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs are toast. They're going to start selling, according to at least one report. And while names like Bobby McMann, Scott Laughton and Morgan Rielly will be getting a lot of buzz, the real (only?) strength of the team at this point is goaltending.
